verdicts.note: Bt toxin sequence B(bacteria make crystals)->E(ingested/inactive protoxin)->C(alkaline pH solubilises)->A(activated)->D(binds midgut) is the standard NCERT order; matches option 4.
Noise stress increases adrenaline secretion, causing nervousness/irritability. Correct.
UV-B is directly absorbed by DNA causing dimers/mutations; UV-C is blocked by ozone, UV-A least energetic. UV-B correct.
Eutrophication: fertilizer runoff (i) + green/stinky bloom (iii) explain fish kill via O2 depletion. Standard answer (i) and (iii).
IUCN maintains the Red Data Book. Correct.
Habitat destruction/loss is the leading cause of biodiversity loss (Evil Quartet). Correct.
Naming, relationships, geographic range are biodiversity-assessment steps; quantifying the genome is the clear outlier. Correct.
Order hinges on fungi vs angiosperm species counts; described global figures actually favour angiosperms>fungi (N>F), so stated F>N is contested/figure-dependent. Cannot confirm.
Azotobacter = free-living aerobic non-photosynthetic N-fixer; Rhizobium symbiotic, Nostoc photosynthetic. Correct.
ANF inhibits (not stimulates) aldosterone. 'Stimulates aldosterone secretion' is the non-function. Correct.
Telophase (spindle breaks down, nuclear envelope reforms) is reverse of prophase. Correct.
In stable environments identical offspring are preadapted. Correct.
Apomixis (seed without fertilization) uses non-vegetative parts; corms/bulbs/rhizomes are vegetative. Correct.
Sexual reproduction under stress generates new recombinant variation increasing diversity. Correct.
Statements (iv) and (v) are truncated/missing from stem and options; cannot confirm the true/false pattern of the stated answer.
(i) arteries thick/narrow lumen TRUE, (iv) Ca2+ in clotting TRUE; (ii) angina=heart not brain FALSE, (iii) AB=recipient not universal donor FALSE. (i)&(iv) correct.
fertilization->zygote->cleavage->morula->blastula->gastrula is the correct developmental order.
Plasmids are vectors because they are small circular DNA with own origin of replication (autonomous replication). Correct.
Universal double-helix structure/nucleotide chemistry lets same techniques work across species. Correct.
Diaphragm's chief role is ventilation (breathing). Correct.
Charged/polar R groups line the channel pore permitting ion passage. Correct.
Without decomposers, nutrient/mineral recycling is blocked. Correct.
Stratification is a structural feature, not an ecosystem function (energy flow/decomposition/productivity are). Correct.
Sparrow (grains=primary consumer, insects=secondary consumer) occupies >1 trophic level. Correct.
Agro-ecosystem (crop field) is man-made/artificial. Correct.
Polio vaccine antigen triggers the body's own response = active immunization. Correct.
Mammalian cells glycosylate (add sugars to make glycoproteins); bacteria cannot. Correct.
Milk's yellow tint is commonly attributed to carotene (fat-soluble); riboflavin gives whey a greenish-yellow. Genuinely contested between carotene and riboflavin options; cannot confirm riboflavin.
Pancreas manufactures many digestive enzymes (exocrine); option a wrongly assigns bile. d is correct/best.
Large intestine reabsorbs remaining water from waste. Correct.
Cryptochromes are blue/UV-A photoreceptors; phytochromes absorb red/far-red. Correct.
Archaebacteria and N-fixing bacteria fall under Monera in the five-kingdom system. Correct.
Same order implies same higher rank Class; Family/Genus/Species are lower and not guaranteed. Correct.
Mycoplasma is pleomorphic due to absence of cell wall (option-d text is garbled DPP metadata but answer stands). Correct.
Only (iii) is false: Branchiostoma is Cephalochordata, not Hemichordata; (i),(ii),(iv) true. '(iii) only' correct.
Origin of the dark (carbonaria) peppered-moth form is due to mutation (then selected). Correct.
